### Preparation

Define functions for running mutational signatures & getting HRdetect scores. 

```{r define_functions}
run_deconstructsigs <- function(data,out_path, out_name, signatures, method = "default", plot=FALSE, cutoff=0.10) {
  # Run deconstructSigs on all samples
  for (i in 1:nrow(data)){
    sample_id=row.names(data[i,])
    sigs= whichSignatures(tumor.ref = data, 
                          signatures.ref = signatures, 
                          sample.id = sample_id,
                          signature.cutoff = cutoff,
                          contexts.needed = TRUE,
                          tri.counts.method = method)
    # Plot signatures if defined
    if ( isTRUE(plot)){
      out_file <- paste0(out_path,"figures/",sample_id,"_",method,"_",out_name,".pdf")
      pdf(out_file)
      plotSignatures(sigs)
      dev.off()
    }
    # Combine sig assignments for samples to one dataframe
    if (exists("sigs_final")) { 
      sigs_final <- rbind(sigs_final,sigs$weights) 
    } else { 
      sigs_final <- sigs$weights
    }
  }
  # Subset only detected signatures
  sigs_detected <- sigs_final %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="Sample")%>%
    gather(Sig, Count, -Sample) %>%
    group_by(Sig) %>%
    filter(Count > 0) %>%
    spread(Sig, Count, fill = 0)
  
  out_file <- paste0(out_path,method,"_",out_name,".tsv")
  # Return signature assigment dataframe
  write.table(sigs_detected, out_file ,quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F)
  return(sigs_detected)
}

get_hrdetect_score <- function(data, std_data){
  intercept <- std_data %>%
    filter(feature == "intercept") %>%
    pluck("weight")
  
  data <- data %>%
    left_join(std_data) %>%
    mutate(norm_value = log(value + 1),
           norm_value = (norm_value - mean)/sd) %>%
    mutate(weighted_value = norm_value*weight) %>%
    group_by(SampleID) %>%
    summarise(sum_values = sum(weighted_value)) %>%
    mutate(hrdetect_score = 1/(1 +exp(-(intercept + sum_values)))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-sum_values)
  
  return(data)
}

rev_char <- function(char) {
    sapply(char, function(a) {
           paste(rev(substring(a,1:nchar(a),1:nchar(a))),collapse="")
    })
}

get_match_length <- function(x, y) { 
    min_length <- min(nchar(x), nchar(y))
    if (min_length == 0) {
        return(0) 
    } else { 
        return(sum(sapply(1:min_length, function(i) {
            substr(x, 1, i) == substr(y, 1, i) 
        })))
    }
}

get_overlap_length <- function(seq1, seq2) {
  overlap_matrix <- sapply(1:nchar(seq1), function(i) {
    subseq1 <- substring(seq1, i, nchar(seq1))
    sapply(1:nchar(seq2), function(j) {
      subseq2 <- substring(seq2, j, nchar(seq2))
      get_match_length(subseq1, subseq2)
    })
  })
  
  return(max(overlap_matrix))
}


get_match_length <- function(x, y) { 
    min_length <- min(nchar(x), nchar(y))
    if (min_length == 0) {
        return(0) 
    } else { 
        return(sum(sapply(1:min_length, function(i) {
            substr(x, 1, i) == substr(y, 1, i) 
        })))
    }
}

microhomology_summary <- function(indel_table) {
    indel_table <- indel_table %>% filter(
        ! is.na(deleted),
        ! is.na(three_prime_flank),
        ! is.na(five_prime_flank)
    ) 

    print('computing match statistics')

    if (dim(indel_table)[1] > 0) {
        three_prime <- apply(indel_table, 1, function(z) {
            get_match_length(z['deleted'], z['three_prime_flank'])
        })

        five_prime <- apply(indel_table, 1, function(z) {
            get_match_length(rev_char(z['deleted']), rev_char(z['five_prime_flank']))
        })

        max_match <- apply(cbind(three_prime, five_prime), 1, max)

        indel_table$microhomology_length <- max_match
        indel_table$is_microhomology <- max_match > 2
    } else {
        indel_table$microhomology_length <- numeric()
        indel_table$is_microhomology <- logical()
    }

    return(indel_table)
}


process.file<-function(svData,sampleName) {
  SV <- svData%>%
  filter(`#CHROM` %in% c(paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X", "Y"))),
         !str_detect(ALT, "_mus_GRCm39"),
         FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  mutate(SV_type = str_extract(INFO, "(?<=SVTYPE=)[^;]+"),
         CHR_end = if_else(SV_type == "BND",
                           str_extract(ALT, "chr[0-9XY]+(_mus_GRCm39)?"),
                           `#CHROM`),
         POS_end = if_else(SV_type == "BND", 
                           as.numeric(str_extract_all(ALT, "(?<=:)[0-9]+")),
                           as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=END=)[^;]+"))),
         distance = if_else(SV_type == "BND", 1, abs(POS- POS_end)),
         length_cat = case_when(SV_type =="BND" ~ "-",
                                distance < 1000 ~ "remove",
                                distance >= 1000 & distance < 10000 ~ "1kb-10kb",
                                distance >=10000 & distance < 100000 ~"10kb-100kb",
                                distance >=100000 & distance < 1000000 ~ "100kb-1mb",
                                distance >=1000000 & distance < 10000000 ~"1mb-10mb",
                                distance >=10000000 ~ ">10mb")) %>%
    filter(CHR_end %in% c(paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X", "Y")))) %>%
    mutate( `#CHROM` = case_when(`#CHROM` == "chrX" ~ 23,
                              `#CHROM` == "chrY" ~ 24,
                              TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub("chr", "", `#CHROM`))),
         CHR_end = case_when(CHR_end == "chrX" ~ 23,
                              CHR_end == "chrY" ~ 24,
                              TRUE ~ as.numeric(gsub("chr", "", CHR_end)))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`#CHROM`) , !is.na(`CHR_end`), length_cat != "remove")%>%
  #filter(length_cat != "remove", !(SV_type == "BND"& `#CHROM` == CHR_end)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr_from = `#CHROM`, chr_from_bkpt = POS, sv_id = ID, annotation = SV_type, length_cat,
                chr_to = CHR_end, chr_to_bkpt = POS_end)

chr.from<-SV[,c("chr_from","chr_from_bkpt","sv_id","annotation","length_cat")]
chr.to<-SV[,c("chr_to","chr_to_bkpt","sv_id","annotation","length_cat")]
colnames(chr.to)<-c("chr_from","chr_from_bkpt","sv_id","annotation","length_cat")
chr.all<-rbind(chr.from,chr.to)
chr.all$chr_from<-as.numeric(chr.all$chr_from)
chr.all<-chr.all[order(chr.all$chr_from,chr.all$chr_from_bkpt),]
    
#Palimpsest - find clustered breakpoints
bkp <- data.frame(chr=chr.all$chr_from,pos=chr.all$chr_from_bkpt,dist=NA,stringsAsFactors=F)
tmp <- sub("X",23,sub("Y",24,bkp$chr));
bkp <- bkp[order(bkp$chr,bkp$pos),]
    for(c in unique(bkp$chr)){
      ind <- which(bkp$chr==c)
      if(length(ind) > 1){
        bkp[ind,] <- bkp[ind[order(bkp[ind,"pos"])],]
        bkp[ind[-1],"dist"] <- bkp[ind[-1],"pos"]-bkp[ind[-length(ind)],"pos"]
      }
    }
    bed <- bkp[,c(1,2,2,3)]
    bed$chr<-paste("chr",bed$chr,sep="")
    indi <- bed2index(bed, sort = TRUE)
    tmp <- cluster.region(x = indi,distance = "1000000",verbose = T)
    tmp[,"chr"] <- data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(tmp$index),':',fixed=TRUE)))[1]
    tmp[,c("start","end")] <- data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(tmp$index),'-',fixed=TRUE)))[2]
    bkp$cluster <- tmp[,"regionIndex"]
    bkp$clustered <- "non_clustered"
    tt <- table(bkp$cluster)
    
    for(clst in names(which(tt >= 10))){
      bkp[which(bkp$cluster==clst),"clustered"] <-"clustered"
    }
    chr.all$palimpsest_cluster_type<-bkp$clustered
    
    
    #Set sv type
    chr.all$sv_type<-apply(chr.all,1,function(x) {
      a=x["annotation"]
      t=""
      if (a == "BND") {
        t="translocation"
      } else if (a == "INV") {
        t="inversion"
      } else if(a == "DEL") {
        t="deletion"
      } else if (a == "DUP") {
        t="duplication"
      }
      return (t)
    })
    
    #Set other end of clustered SVs to clustered
    clustered<-chr.all$sv_id[chr.all$palimpsest_cluster_type == "clustered"]
    chr.all$palimpsest_cluster_type[chr.all$sv_id %in% clustered]<-"clustered"
    
    chr.all$sv_sig_type<-paste(chr.all$sv_type,chr.all$palimpsest_cluster_type,chr.all$length_cat,sep=":")
    chr.all$SampleID <-sampleName
    return(chr.all)
  }
```

### HRdetect prep

#### microhomology
adapted from Felicity's script 
Computes HRDetect microhomology scores as described by Davies et al. (2017).
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/28288110.

```{r}
library(VariantAnnotation)
indels <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/clairs_to/indel.vcf.gz"),
            Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/clairs_to/indel.vcf.gz"))%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, skip ="#CHROM") %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
   filter(!str_detect(FILTER, "LowQual"), !str_detect(FILTER, "NonSomatic"),
          `#CHROM` %in%  c(paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X", "Y")))) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, `#CHROM`, POS, REF, ALT, FILTER, INFO)

five_prime_flank <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, indels$`#CHROM`, indels$POS - 25, indels$POS)
three_prime_flank <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, indels$`#CHROM`, indels$POS + 1, indels$POS + 26)
deleted <- as.character(sapply(indels$REF, function(z) {substring(z, 2, nchar(z))}))

indel_flanked <- cbind(indels, tibble(deleted = as.character(deleted),
                                five_prime_flank = as.character(five_prime_flank), 
                                three_prime_flank = as.character(three_prime_flank)))%>% 
  microhomology_summary()

microhomology <- indel_flanked %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
    summarise(
        deletion_microhomology_count = sum(is_microhomology),
        deletion_count = n()) %>%
    mutate(deletion_microhomology_proportion = if_else(deletion_count == 0, 0, deletion_microhomology_count / deletion_count))
```

#### Rearrangement signature analysis

Pre-process qSV outputs for SV signature analysis (script written by Felicity Newell).  
  


  
Run YAPSA to assign RS (SV) signatures. Starting point matlab input file created by Felicity.  
   
```{r SV_sig_assignment}

subtypes.vec<-c("deletion:clustered:1kb-10kb","deletion:clustered:10kb-100kb","deletion:clustered:100kb-1mb","deletion:clustered:1mb-10mb","deletion:clustered:>10mb",
                  "duplication:clustered:1kb-10kb","duplication:clustered:10kb-100kb","duplication:clustered:100kb-1mb","duplication:clustered:1mb-10mb","duplication:clustered:>10mb",
                  "inversion:clustered:1kb-10kb","inversion:clustered:10kb-100kb","inversion:clustered:100kb-1mb","inversion:clustered:1mb-10mb","inversion:clustered:>10mb",
                  "translocation:clustered:-",
                  "deletion:non_clustered:1kb-10kb","deletion:non_clustered:10kb-100kb","deletion:non_clustered:100kb-1mb","deletion:non_clustered:1mb-10mb","deletion:non_clustered:>10mb",
                  "duplication:non_clustered:1kb-10kb","duplication:non_clustered:10kb-100kb","duplication:non_clustered:100kb-1mb","duplication:non_clustered:1mb-10mb","duplication:non_clustered:>10mb",
                  "inversion:non_clustered:1kb-10kb","inversion:non_clustered:10kb-100kb","inversion:non_clustered:100kb-1mb","inversion:non_clustered:1mb-10mb","inversion:non_clustered:>10mb",
                  "translocation:non_clustered:-")
  types.vec<-c(rep("clustered",16),rep("non_clustered",16))
  allcounts.df=data.frame("Type"=types.vec,"SubType"=subtypes.vec)
  
  SV <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/SV/*.nanomonsv.result.vcf"),
          Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/SV/*.nanomonsv.result.vcf"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, skip = "#CHROM") %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))
  RE <- SV %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_map(~process.file(.x, .y$SampleID), .keep = T)
  
  allcounts.df <- allcounts.df %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(RE) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, palimpsest_cluster_type, sv_sig_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  dplyr::rename( Type =  palimpsest_cluster_type, SubType = sv_sig_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SampleID, values_from = n)) 
  
  allcounts.df[is.na(allcounts.df)]=0
  
  
sv_total_counts <- allcounts.df%>%
  dplyr::select(-Type,-SubType) %>%
  gather(key = SampleID, value = "N") %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  summarise(Total_count = sum(N))


nikzainal_SV_sigs <- read_tsv("../ref/nz_sv_sigs.txt" ) %>%
  arrange(factor(subtypes, levels = allcounts.df$SubType)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("subtypes")

allcounts.df %<>%
   dplyr::select(-Type) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SubType")

sv_sigs_raw <- LCD(
  in_mutation_catalogue_df = allcounts.df,
  in_signatures_df = nikzainal_SV_sigs)

sv_sigs_assigned <- sv_sigs_raw %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sig") %>%
  gather(key= SampleID, value = count_raw, - Sig) %>%
  left_join(sv_total_counts)  %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  mutate(Count = count_raw/sum(count_raw)*Total_count) %>%
  mutate(Perc = Count/Total_count*100) %>%
  mutate(Count = if_else(Perc > 10, round(Count), 0)) %>%
  mutate(Perc = if_else(Perc > 10, Perc, 0))  %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total_count, -count_raw)

write.table(sv_sigs_assigned, "../output/scarHRD/RearrangmentSignature.tsv",quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")
```

```{r scarHRD, message = FALSE}
CNV <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"),
         Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome = chromosome, Start_position = start, End_position =end, total_cn = copyNumber, B_cn = minorAlleleCopyNumber) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn), B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn)),
    A_cn = total_cn - B_cn) %>%
  left_join(ploidy %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ploidy)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Chromosome, grp = cumsum(lag(A_cn, default = first(A_cn)) != A_cn | 
                                    lag(B_cn, default = first(B_cn)) != B_cn | 
                                    lag(total_cn, default = first(total_cn)) != total_cn)) %>%
  summarise(
    Start_position = first(Start_position),
    End_position = last(End_position),
    A_cn = first(A_cn),
    B_cn = first(B_cn),
    total_cn = first(total_cn),
    ploidy = first(ploidy),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-grp)%>%
  ungroup()

CNV %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~ {
    write_tsv(.x, paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/scarHRD/",.y$SampleID, ".scarHRD.input.txt"))
    scar_score(paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/scarHRD/",.y$SampleID, ".scarHRD.input.txt"),
               reference = "grch38" ,seqz = FALSE, outputdir = "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/scarHRD/")
    }, keep = TRUE)

scarHRD_summary <- list.files(path="/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/scarHRD",
                            pattern = "_HRDresults.txt$",
                            full.names = T,
                            recursive = F) %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.,col.names = c("SampleID", "LOH", "TAI", "LST", "HRD_Score"), colClasses = c("character", "integer", "integer", "integer", "integer")))
```


### HRdetect predictions

First, clean up all the inputs for HRdetect input.  

```{r clean_up}

hrdetect_input <- snv_hrdetect_sigs %>%
  full_join(scarHRD_summary %>% dplyr::select(SampleID , HRD_Score) %>% 
              distinct()) %>%
  full_join(microhomology %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, deletion_microhomology_proportion)%>%
              distinct()) %>%
  inner_join(sv_sigs_assigned %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, Count, Sig) %>%
              mutate(Sig = str_replace(Sig, "Rearrangement Signature ","rs")) %>%
               distinct() %>%
              spread(key = Sig, value = Count) %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, rs3,rs5)) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID,Sig3,Sig8,
         rs3,rs5,
         `HRD-sum`=HRD_Score,deletion_microhomology_proportion) %>%
  # drop_na() %>%
  gather(key = feature, value = value, 
         -SampleID) %>%
  mutate(feature = case_when(feature == "Sig3" ~ "sig3",
                             feature == "Sig8" ~ "sig8",
                             feature == "HRD-sum" ~ "hrd",
                             feature == "deletion_microhomology_proportion" ~ "mhom",
                             TRUE ~ feature)) %>%
  distinct()
hrdetect_input[is.na(hrdetect_input)] =0

```

```{r hrdetect_manual}

hrd_adj_val <- read_tsv("../ref/hrdetect_adjustment_values.tsv")


hrdetect_output <- get_hrdetect_score(hrdetect_input,hrd_adj_val)

```

```{r summary_output}
hrdetect_all <- hrdetect_output %>%
  left_join(hrdetect_input %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value)) %>%
  left_join(scarHRD_summary )


hrdetect_all%>%
  write_tsv("../output/hrdetect.tsv")

```
